_about: TASKSCREEN 2026-10-28: the Task screen's categories (Durango's Task screen). Sources: docs/reference/durango_all_tasks_research.xlsx (Task Board sheet, ids DW-T01xx in 'source'; see docs/reference/tasks.md). Main Task = the standing orders of objectives.json (and the tutorial orders while the tutorial runs), with their own xp / t_stones. The sheet records almost no reward amounts or quantities, so every 'want' and reward below that the sheet leaves blank is an ASSUMPTION (logged in docs/vision/WildLandsMMO_Open_Questions.md TS1-TS12). Rewards are claimed by hand with Receive. Daily resets at 00:00 UTC, weekly at Monday 00:00 UTC. 'count' names what is counted (Tasks.note kinds, or 'craft:<recipe id>'); a list sums. 'hidden': true = data only, not shown or tracked (the game has no system for it yet; '_why' says what is missing).
